text:
**Best pick under $1,000: BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 at $899.** It has the most battery for the money among the units in these results, though the sources disagree on its price (see the note below). I haven't tested any of these myself. Specs and prices come from the sources cited.

## Top picks

**1. BLUETTI Elite 200 V2: best overall ($899)**
- 2,074 Wh, 2,600 W output, LiFePO4 battery rated for 6,000 cycles. The sources estimate about 23 hours for a fridge, CPAP and router together.
- It can't be expanded later.
- Buy: https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-200-v2. Code AFF5OFF took it to $854.05 in a cart test on 2026-10-25.
- Sources: [Outage Outfitter](https://outageoutfitter.com/best/under-1000/), [Compare Power Stations](https://comparepowerstations.com/best/best-under-1000/), [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/bluetti-discount-codes)

**2. Anker SOLIX C2000 Gen 2: best if you want to expand later ($899.99)**
- 2,048 Wh, 2,400 W, a UPS-style switchover of about 10 ms, and an add-on BP2000 battery that can double it to 4 kWh.
- I don't have a direct buy link from the results. Outage Authority's page links to Amazon: https://outageauthority.com/roundups/best-power-station-home-backup

**3. BLUETTI AC180: best budget pick ($499)**
- 1,152 Wh, 1,800 W, and about 13 hours of fridge, CPAP and router. It has the lowest price per watt-hour of the 1 kWh class here.
- Buy: https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac180 ($474.05 with AFF5OFF, tested 2026-10-21).

**4. Jackery Explorer 1000 v2: lightest ($489)**
- 1,070 Wh, 1,500 W, 23.8 lb, but only 400 W solar input and no expansion.
- The $489 price is at Outbound Power. Jackery's own store raised it to $559.
- Details: https://outageauthority.com/reviews/jackery-explorer-1000-v2

**Also worth a look:** the Anker SOLIX F1500 (1,536 Wh, $599.99) ranked first on spec value at [Compare Power Stations](https://comparepowerstations.com/best/best-under-1000/). The BLUETTI Elite 100 V2 (1,024 Wh, $499) is listed at [Home Depot](https://www.homedepot.com/p/337557774) but shows out of stock.

## Things to know
- **Elite 200 V2 price conflict:** Outage Authority said it went back to $1,199 on Oct 7. Dealectric verified $899 on Oct 27, and Compare and Outage Outfitter also list $899. Check the price at checkout.
- **Discount codes:** AFF5OFF (5% off) passed Bluetti's cart test. Outage Authority lists "AFF5%", which I couldn't verify. AFFSALE was rejected.
- **Affiliate links:** the Dealectric links are affiliate links and pay a commission at no cost to you.
- **Limits:** none of these gives 240 V output, so they won't run a well pump or central AC. For that you'd need something like the EcoFlow Delta Pro 3 ($2,799), which is over budget.

Tell me what you need to run (fridge, CPAP, window AC) and how long, and I can narrow it to one.
